newsitem.title: USA: O'Sullivan Industries to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: O'Sullivan Industries to buy back shares.

text.p: O'Sullivan Industries Holdings Inc said Tuesday its board of directors authorized the repurchase of up to five percent of its common stock over the next 24 months.

As of May 5, O'Sullivan had about 16.8 million shares of common stock outstanding, at a closing price of $14.125 a share. At this price, the repurchase program is valued at almost $12.0 million, it added.

The stock will be repurchased from time to time at prevailing prices in open market transactions, it added. The share repurchases will be funded from available working capital and added to the company's treasury.
O'Sullivan said the program, which includes no specific pricing or timing targets, could be suspended at any time or terminated prior to completion.

"The company's performance over the last several quarters has been very solid as our business outlook has strengthened," Daniel O'Sullivan, chairman, said in a statement. (CORRECTS QUOTE) "Increasing profitability and strong cash flow have enabled the company to reduce its debt levels and increase its available cash position."
O'Sullivan said its board also instituted a stock ownership policy for directors and officers of the company.
